Kneel beside the cushion. Your full uppe.es: Arrodíllate junto al cojín. Todo tu torso debe quedar a la vista de la cámara.
Kneel beside the cushion. Your full uppe.fr: Agenouille-toi à côté du coussin. Tout le haut de ton corps doit être visible par la caméra.

Kneel beside the cushion. Your full uppe.ko: 쿠션 옆에 무릎을 꿇으세요. 상체 전체가 카메라에 보여야 해요.
Kneel beside the cushion. Your full uppe.zh: 跪在垫子旁。确保整个上半身都在摄像头画面中。

Kneel beside the manikin, side-on to the.zh: 跪在模拟人旁，侧身对着摄像头，手腕上戴好手表。

Lean forward so your shoulders are above.es: Inclínate hacia delante para que los hombros queden sobre las manos.

Shoulder, elbow and wrist not all visibl.fr: Épaule, coude et poignet pas encore tous visibles

Switch now. Next rescuer, start compress.fr: Changez maintenant. Sauveteur suivant, commence les compressions.
Switch now. Next rescuer, start compress.hi: अभी बदलिए। अगले बचावकर्ता, कंप्रेशन शुरू कीजिए।

Tilt the head back, lift the chin, 2 bre.fr: Bascule la tête en arrière, élève le menton, 2 insufflations d'une seconde chacune. Puis reprends aussitôt les compressions.

Tilt the head back, lift the chin, 2 bre.ja: 頭部後屈あご先挙上をして、1秒かけて人工呼吸を2回。すぐに胸骨圧迫に戻って。
Tilt the head back, lift the chin, 2 bre.ko: 머리 젖히고 턱 들기를 한 뒤, 1초씩 2회 인공호흡하세요. 그다음 바로 가슴압박으로 돌아가세요.
